node.html:
• Developed and maintained a school management system (SAGE) to support academic and administrative operations, including student records, attendance, and internal workflows.

  • Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js, applying clear endpoint structure, validation, and business rules.

  • Modeled and maintained a relational database, ensuring data consistency, integrity, and efficient query performance.

  • Implemented backend logic to manage student, teacher, and staff data, improving the reliability of academic and administrative processes.

  • Collaborated directly with administrative staff, teachers, and students to gather requirements, validate features, and iteratively improve the system.

  • Applied best practices in backend development, focusing on code organization, maintainability, and scalability in a real institutional environment.
